The '''2004–05 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 69th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 18 September 2004 and ended on 25 May 2005. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 33rd Greek title.
